outgoing.name: France
outgoing.excerpt: The French Southern and Antarctic Lands have formed a territoire d'outre-mer (an overseas territory) of France since 1955.

outgoing.name: Internet
outgoing.excerpt: The territory's data code is FS and its ISO 3166-1 country code (top level Internet domain) is TF.

outgoing.name: Tourism
outgoing.excerpt: Marion Dufresne can host a limited number of fee-paying tourists, who will be able to visit the islands as the ship calls.
